Dashboard head (styles + CSV helper)
format:
<style>
/* Shared look for the cold-chain dashboard widgets */
.cc-card { background:#0f172a; border:1px solid #1e293b; border-radius:10px; padding:10px 12px; color:#e2e8f0;
           height:100%; box-sizing:border-box; }
.cc-muted { color:#94a3b8; font-size:11px; }
.cc-label { color:#94a3b8; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.6px; text-transform:uppercase; }
.cc-badge { color:#0b1120; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.5px; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:999px; }
.cc-tiles { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4, 1fr); gap:6px; }
.cc-tile  { background:#0f172a; border:1px solid #1e293b; border-radius:8px; padding:6px 4px; text-align:center; }
.cc-tile .v { font-size:17px; font-weight:800; color:#e2e8f0; white-space:nowrap; }
.cc-tile .k { font-size:9px; color:#94a3b8; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.5px; text-transform:uppercase; }
.cc-chip { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:#0f172a; border:1px solid #1e293b; border-radius:999px;
           padding:5px 14px; font-size:12px; color:#e2e8f0; white-space:nowrap; }
.cc-dot  { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; flex:none; }
.cc-dot.pulse { animation: ccPulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes ccPulse { 50% { opacity:.35; } }
</style>
<script>
// Shared CSV download helper for the dashboard (loaded once in the page head).
// cols = [[header, valueFn, isText]]. Text cells are guarded against CSV/formula injection:
// event text can contain attacker-controlled payload snippets, so a leading = + - @ is neutralised.
window.ccCsv = function (filename, rows, cols) {
    var pad = function (n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); };
    var cell = function (v, isText) {
        v = v === undefined || v === null ? '' : String(v);
        if (isText && /^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(v)) v = "'" + v;
        return /[",\r\n]/.test(v) ? '"' + v.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"' : v;
    };
    var lines = [cols.map(function (c) { return c[0]; }).join(',')];
    rows.forEach(function (r) { lines.push(cols.map(function (c) { return cell(c[1](r), c[2]); }).join(',')); });
    var csv = lines.join('\r\n');
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(['﻿' + csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' }));
    a.download = filename;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); a.remove(); }, 1000);
    return csv;
};
window.ccTime = function (ts) {
    var d = new Date(ts), p = function (n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); };
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate()) + ' ' +
        p(d.getHours()) + ':' + p(d.getMinutes()) + ':' + p(d.getSeconds());
};
window.ccStamp = function () { return window.ccTime(Date.now()).replace(/[-: ]/g, '').slice(0, 12); };
</script>
